job.title: Frontend Engineer - SAP Commerce Cloud
job.email_subject: Application: Frontend Engineer - SAP Commerce Cloud
job.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Your storefront needs an engineer who knows SAP Commerce Cloud from the API to the screen – I have delivered both sides for Rockwell Automation and Shell for 5+ years.

– Developed OCC REST web services (headless APIs) for storefronts, PWA frontends and third-party consumers
– Used generative AI / LLM tools extensively across analysis, development, testing and documentation
– Executed CI/CD deployment cycles and release builds on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2)

I am fully set up for remote collaboration with your Sofia team. I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026 after my notice period. Would you have 15 minutes for a short call in the coming days? My CV and cover letter are attached.

Kind regards
Kranti Chavan

tailoring.headline: Frontend & Storefront Engineer – SAP Commerce Cloud | PWA, OCC APIs, JavaScript
tailoring.summary: SAP Commerce Cloud engineer with 5+ years on enterprise B2B and B2C platforms (Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell, delivering both backend and frontend functionality. Builds OCC REST web services for headless storefronts and Progressive Web Application (PWA) frontends, customizes storefronts with JavaScript and responsive design, and connects them to product, catalog, pricing and customer data. Works hands-on with AI-assisted development, code reviews and CI/CD deployment cycles on CCv2 in agile, international teams. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.
tailoring.why_company: dormakaba's SAP Commerce Cloud platform is 100% tailor-made and deeply integrated – the kind of system where storefront work has real business impact. With 5+ years delivering frontend and backend functionality on Hybris 2105/2211, OCC APIs for PWA frontends and daily AI-assisted development, I can contribute quickly to your digital customer experience.

en.subject: Application: Frontend Engineer - SAP Commerce Cloud

bullets.label: Storefront & frontend development

bullets.label: AI-supported delivery

bullets.label: Quality & teamwork
bullets.text: Performed code reviews, executed CI/CD deployment cycles on CCv2 and collaborated with backend engineers, business stakeholders and international teams.
